probe.text_sample: Connecting the threads between ecology, culture, and spirituality – Emergence Magazine Engage Print Podcast Store Stories Menu Emergence Magazine Skip to content Emergence Magazine Engage Print Podcast Store Stories Menu Emergence Magazine Volume 7: SEEDS AND STRUCTURES $40.00 Order Now Essay Protecting Bahsahwahbee A Living Refuge for the Ancestors by Josh Jackson Guided by Newe elders Delaine and Rick Spilsbury, writer Josh Jackson traces what could be lost if the springs that sustain a sacred grove of Rocky Mountain junipers in far eastern Nevada run dry. Read Essay Editorial Statement We believe it has always been a radical act to share stories during dark times. As we experience the desecration of our lands and waters, the extinguishing of species, and a loss of sacred connection to the Earth, we look to emerging stories. In them we find the timeless connections between ecology, culture, and spirituality.
